qualification.details: Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering/Chemistry/Physics/Materials Science/Mechanical Engineering/Bioengineering or closely related disciplines. Well conversant with theoretical foundations of molecular simulations and open source tools (GROMACS, LAMMPS, etc.) OR extensive experience in synthesis and characterization of drug delivery systems. Strong academic credentials. At least 2 high quality, original research publications (review articles not considered). Prior experience in both computational and experimental work may be preferred, but is not mandatory.

content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Roorkee Post Doctoral Fellowship Position Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 14-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Post Doctoral Fellowship Position at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email is 14th September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated email address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What are the minimum qualifications required for this fellowship?
faq.answer: A Ph.D. in Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, Physics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Bioengineering, or related disciplines is required. Additionally, expertise in molecular simulations or drug delivery systems and at least two high-quality research publications are necessary.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The fellowship offers a salary of Rs. 80,000.00 per month plus HRA. An additional contingency amount of Rs. 50,000.00 per annum is also provided.

faq.question: Q4. How should I apply for this position?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted via email. You need to send a covering letter, CV, reference letters, publication list, and a research statement in a single PDF file to the specified email address.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this Post Doctoral Fellowship Position. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q6. What is the job type for this fellowship?
faq.answer: This is a temporary position. The fellowship is offered on a temporary basis for research purposes.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this Post Doctoral Fellowship Position recruitment is IITR/CH/PDF/26-27/PKJ/01.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the Post Doctoral Fellowship?
faq.answer: The selection process will involve an initial screening of applications followed by an interview for shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT Roorkee provide any age relaxation for this position?
faq.answer: The official notification does not specify any age limits or age relaxation details for this Post Doctoral Fellowship Position.

faq.question: Q10. What is the location of the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee?
faq.answer: Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee is located in Roorkee, Uttarakhand, with the pincode 247667.
